notes: Sheet drawn north up. Names printed 'HOPPLE', 'GARRARD', 'TERRACE PL.', 'JESSAMINE', 'COLERAIN AV.', 'HENSHAW AV.', 'RACHEL', 'SPRING GROVE AVE.', 'TOWNSHIP'; suffix-less names recorded as Street. Hopple is in two legs: a 40' E-W leg west of Colerain and a 50' leg running ENE east of Colerain; they meet Colerain about 230 px apart, so two T points are given. Township likewise jogs at Spring Grove (west leg 40', centre y~6845; east leg 50', centre y~6943) and again at Colerain (west leg horizontal, east leg rises ENE), so two T points at each. Garrard runs down the west edge (45' south of Hopple, 30' north of it); its west line is off the page, so its centreline is taken 135 px (22.5 ft) west of the drawn east line, which matches the water pipe in it. Township continues west of Garrard (key map), so Garrard/Township is a cross. Henshaw and Rachel, Hopple and Township all run off the east edge; Henshaw/Township is off the sheet. Spring Grove's curve is recorded as bends.
